programme.title: The Lady Professional
programme.desc: Lily Ho is perfectly cast as a gun-for-hire who always gets her man - in more ways than one! The cast and crew shot on location in Japanese scenic spots such as Mount Fuji; and there are plenty of over-the-top thrills, as Lily even masquerades as a nun.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: Heroes Of Sung
programme.desc: Heroes Of Sung stars one of the original kung fu ladies of the silver screen, Shih Szu, who plays swordswoman Meng Hung. She must work with Fan Tien-Fu, played by Lo Lieh to find and protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty. Shih's magnificent performance earned her the female hero role in another hit Dracula And The 7 Golden Vampires.

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: Murderer Pursues
programme.desc: Wang Chung was a valued actor long before he became a director, but as a filmmaker, he helped create some of the most interesting thrillers Shaw Brothers ever released - including this fascinating crime saga of a Sino-Vietnamese crime gang. Danny Lee stars as a misunderstood refugee while Ray Lui plays a cop struggling against his own conscience to ensure that justice is upheld.

programme.title: Masked Avengers
programme.desc: Masked killers are wreaking havoc and instilling terror with their vicious weapons of choice: razor-sharp, gut-shattering tridents. Only three fearless fighters dare investigate, leading to mass murder and magnificent martial arts. Chien Hsiao-hou, future co-star of Yuen Woo-ping's THE TAI-CHI MASTER joins the trio to get tri-pierced.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This joyous, raucous, & colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats
programme.desc: Tou Kuan is a wealthy Kwangtung brat with a good kung fu background, he has only one ambition: to pit his wits against three shady masters of the North. The first, conman Che Tsai. The second, a professional romantic dubbed The Terrific. Terrific introduces Tou Kuan to his third rival, Thief Shih San-shou.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family's young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo's stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chen's past insult.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan and disintegrating them from the inside. As more internal conflicts occur, will the masterminds of the clan find out who are the spys?

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Duke's daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: Judgement of an Assassin
programme.desc: An evil clan plans a discord so as to dominate the martial arts world. Their masked assassins massacre another clan and one of the assassins is arrested and brought to trial at a tribunal of all the clans. What judgement will they make and can they uncover the truth?

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Linda's tragic suicide.

programme.title: Portrait In Crystal
programme.desc: Tragic deaths in the underworld cause leader "Yama" (Teng Wei-hao) to suspect a portrait in crystal with mysterious powers. He sends Hen Pan (Chen Hung) and Pai Pan (Hung Hsin-nan) to interrogate its creator, martial artist Lung Fei (Pai Piao)...

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: The Singing Thief
programme.desc: A master jewel thief turns over a new leaf as a professional singer in a nightclub. However, a series of robberies happened shortly after and he becomes the suspect again. The thief then sets up a trap to snare the copycat but will this backfire on him?

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical "Lucky Casino" and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: Aptly described by its original title of "Money, Sex And Love", this is a gripping drama about Judy, a woman with a rich husband as well as two lovers who happen to be brothers. Jenny Hu is Judy, and her knockout beauty makes this summer sizzle...

programme.title: The Fighting Fool
programme.desc: Famous Kung Fu Pole master Red Eagle, is kidnapped by a villain one day. His disciple Meng, vows to rescue him. On his way, Meng encounters a greedy but great martial artist who agrees to join him in the rescue. Even though the two have extremely different personalities, they manage to team up and fight the villain in a final showdown.

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demon's clutches.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: Sima works for a corrupt lord Qin who is suffering from a deadly disease that only a special herb can cure. Qin sends him on an urgent mission to retrieve it, but the task is made more difficult when Sima has to fight off other martial artists who want to steal the cure away from him. He has to fight with his ultimate weapon, the Dragon Missile!

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: A young business man marries a pretty and much sought-after young bride, not knowing that she carries the spirit of a girl raped by her uncle and murdered along with her parents. Justice must be done, and it ain't pretty!

programme.title: Finger of Doom
programme.desc: The protagonists are ex-swordmasters who now find joy in making umbrellas. They track down the evil Madame Kung Sun and her poisonous "Finger of Doom", a unique supernatural power which allows her to transform normal, everyday people into horrifying zombies, and this is just the start of their mythical adventure against this zombie maker!

programme.title: Finger of Doom
programme.desc: The protagonists are ex-swordmasters who now find joy in making umbrellas. They track down the evil Madame Kung Sun and her poisonous "Finger of Doom", a unique supernatural power which allows her to transform normal, everyday people into horrifying zombies, and this is just the start of their mythical adventure against this zombie maker!

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: This is a love story between an alluring fairy, Seventh Sister, who comes down from heaven to experience life in 70's Hong Kong, and a man who is running a debt laden orphanage. A heartless tycoon plans to take over the orphanage for its land but has to deal with Seventh Sister's magical powers as she aims to protect it from falling into his hands!

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddha's Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon unleashes a storm upon the martial arts world...

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancee to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies...

programme.title: Duel Of Fist
programme.desc: Fan Ke discovers at his father's deathbed that he has a half-brother, Wenlie, in Thailand. He goes to find Wenlie, who became a boxer to support his sick mother. Following their encounter, the two got involved in the underworld of boxing match gambling.

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: In this action comedy, two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and accidentally become patriotic heroes. Assisted by a warlord's daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his "Crazy Lo Han Fist" improves with every fight.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: Meng Xiang Cheng - EP15
programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society’s conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: Love and Let Love!
programme.desc: Cliff proposes to his girlfriend Terry but is killed in a car accident before she says "yes". Terry is devastated and inconsolable. When Cliff's ghost returns, they seem to go back to their good old days. However, Cliff is determined to help Terry get over his death and start anew.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: In Cycle
programme.desc: A seemingly happy couple who loves diving come to a deserted island for a diving vacation, which is part of the husband’s plan to murder his wife. His conspiracy however, is intervened by a series of bizarre events on the island. Can the couple eventually escape from the enigmatic ocean?

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, Fat is a gangster who suffers from amnesia. Believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters’ best ally. To complicate matters further, a gangster named Wind, who looks exactly like Fat, starts a turf war with Big Bro.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong’s biggest stars

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: City of Desire
programme.desc: Sister 13 returns to Macau after 17 years to succeed her father’s underground empire, the prostitution business. She tries to stop their exploitation of the sex workers, but Macau’s economy flourished after the handover, propelling the prostitution and gambling businesses. The city is blinded by desire and Sister 13 can do nothing to help...

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder happens, and the suspects get killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy over two generations.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man's matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.desc: Desperate to save Wingnut from Tokka, Rahzar, &amp; the Monster Mutanimals, Donnie delves deeper into the lab of a mad scientist. Meanwhile, his brothers follow another Tokka to the Staten Island lab... only for things to take a disastrous turn!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S2 - The Rejects
programme.desc: When Leo, Mikey, and Raph are captured by the mad scientist Jordan Perry and his Monster Mutanimals, Donnie must stop a mutant invasion on Staten Island and save everyone from the terrifying creation known as Mutant Omega!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S13 - My Friend Patty Fun-Believable
programme.desc: SpongeBob befriends a sentient Krabby Patty whose only wish is to be eaten. Rube hosts an episode of "FUN-Believable! With Rube" where he explores little known oddities and attractions around Bikini Bottom.

programme.title: Best and Bester S1 - In the Sky Best Buddies

programme.title: Best and Bester S1 - Donut Disturb The Cursed Amulet
programme.desc: Bester unwittingly uncovers the not so delicious goings on in Fritz Fritter's top secret Donut Wonderland Factory. Best and Bester dig up Captain Ironfoot's Cursed Amulet on the beach only to find that Deep Sea Belle wants it too.

programme.title: Best and Bester S1 - That's So Cupid Buddy Odour
programme.desc: Inspired by the latest Romcom release at the Movie Theatre, Best and Bester decide to go on a match-making mission. Toot moves into the Sub with Best and Bester, but they find there's no getting away from her smell - literally!

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S1 - The Yard Sale
programme.desc: GrandPat prevents his precious memories from being sold at a family yard sale.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S1 - Squidina's Little Helper I Smell a Pat
programme.desc: The Patrick Star Show is interrupted by a most peculiar stench. Squidina hires an assistant who's a little too good at his job.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 - Lost in Bikini Bottom Tutor Sauce
programme.desc: SpongeBob tries to take a shortcut to work, but becomes lost along the way. After failing his driver's test again, Mr. Krabs decides to teach SpongeBob how to drive himself.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 - Squid Plus One
programme.desc: After receiving an invitation to a gallery opening, Squidward scrambles to find a friend to take with him,.

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover S2 - Cruel Summer
programme.desc: Max and Phoebe are working well as a team, until he is accused of committing crimes and Phoebe must apprehend him. Now on the lam, Max learns that the Mastermind's henchman is secretly controlling his actions via a chip in his neck.

programme.title: Danger Force S1 - Captain Man Strikes Out
programme.desc: When Captain Man goes on strike because he refuses to pay for art that he destroyed on a mission, the Vice-Mayor hires a new hero to defend Swellview - Monsieur Man.

programme.title: Henry Danger S2 - Captain Man: On Vacation
programme.desc: Ray has trusted Henry and Charlotte with protecting Swellview while he's out of town at his cousin's wedding. Problems arise when they find themselves having to handle things on their own.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S2 - Raph Fights Everyone
programme.desc: With all his family and friends under Kitsune's mind control, Raph no longer wants to fight in the Mutant Battle Arena. But he'll have to (with Pigeon Pete's help) in order to save EVERYONE he loves before it's too late!

programme.title: The Loud House S8 - Bulking and Sulking Wild Goss Chase
programme.desc: Dad struggles to run Lynn's Table when his brother Lance opens up a gym above the restaurant. Privy to all the gossip at school, Lola is recruited to write her own gossip column in the school newspaper.

programme.title: The Loud House S1 - Two Boys and a Baby
programme.desc: Thinking it'll be easy, Lincoln and Clyde take on the task of babysitting the youngest Loud, Lily.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S15 - Delivery of Doom My Father the Boat
programme.desc: SpongeBob is challenged by E.V.I.L. to make a delivery to their secret lair in 10 minutes or less. When Mr. Krabs gets trapped inside of Pearl's new boat, he must pretend to be its engine to avoid being caught.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S15 - Who's Afraid of Mr. Snippers? A Fish Called Sandy
programme.desc: Squidward and Plankton take to the stage to take down a common adversary. To experience the ocean firsthand, Sandy swaps genes with a fish.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S13 - Say 'Awww!'
programme.desc: Frustrated that he's seen as cute instead of evil, Plankton builds a robot to punish anyone who says "aww!"

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S1 - The Patterfly Effect A Space Affair to Remember
programme.desc: Patrick messes with the space-time continuum. While Cecil and Bunny celebrate their anniversary in outer space, Patrick and Squidina throw a house party.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S1 - Home Ecch! Fun & Done!
programme.desc: Squidina hosts a television show to pass a home economics class. Patrick and SpongeBob try to unlock a dull child's imagination.

programme.title: The Loud House S2 - The Loudest Mission: Relative Chaos
programme.desc: Bobby fits in great but Ronnie Anne struggles with the smothering nature of their relatives. Little do they know, their mother has a secret motive.

programme.title: The Loud House S2 - Out of the Picture Room with a Feud
programme.desc: Afraid they'll be forgotten, Lincoln and Clyde want to make a splash in the yearbook and crash group photos. Seeing his sisters fight with their roommates, Lincoln suggests a room shuffle based on a compatibility test.

programme.title: The Loud House S2 - Fool's Paradise Job Insecurity
programme.desc: With prankster Luan at camp for April Fool's Day, the Louds think they're safe. That is, until they break down in front of an unusual motel. The kids discover Dad isn't at his IT job anymore and is now a dishwasher.

programme.title: The Loud House S2 - Future Tense Lynner Takes All
programme.desc: When Mom and Dad meet an impressive family they worry their kids aren't doing enough to ensure successful futures. Tired of Lynn's poor sportsmanship during board games, the siblings decide to team up to take her down.

programme.title: Wylde Pak S2 - Summer Chuseok Putting Up with the Plovers
programme.desc: In an attempt to get out of the dentist, Lily insists on a summer celebration of the fall holiday Chuseok. When Will accidentally befriends an annoying man, his sorry attempts at a break-up make things painfully awkward for the whole family.

programme.title: Wylde Pak S2 - The Real Woori World The Collector

programme.desc: SpongeBob learns his milkshake license has expired, and is forced to go back to the milkshake academy. Squidward hits his head and reverts to being a baby, and it's up to SpongeBob and Patrick to take care of him.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 - Little Yellow Book Bumper to Bumper

programme.title: The Loud House S1 - Heavy Meddle Making the Case

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover S2 - Cruel Summer

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3 - Nature Vs Nurture
programme.desc: Daniel and Johnny team up to find Robby. Miguel faces an uncertain future. Kreese tries to bring Tory back to Cobra Kai.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3 - Now You're Gonna Pay
programme.desc: Daniel's tarnished public image takes a toll on his sales, leading to a takeover offer. Johnny tries to raise money for Miguel's surgery.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3 - The Right Path
programme.desc: Following an important meeting in Japan, Daniel revisits Mr. Miyagi's hometown in Okinawa. Johnny attempts to reconnect with Robby.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3 - Miyagi-Do
programme.desc: In Okinawa, Daniel spends time with an old friend - and an old enemy, who has much to teach him. The dueling dojos' rivalry comes to a nasty head.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3 - King Cobra
programme.desc: Miguel helps Johnny craft the perfect social media message. Kreese scouts new recruits while Daniel and Amanda try to shut down Cobra Kai.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3 - Obstculos
programme.desc: Daniel spends some father-daughter time with a traumatized Sam. Johnny plans to form a new karate dojo but struggles to come up with a cool name.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3 - The Good, The Bad And The Badass
programme.desc: Informed that this year's All Valley Karate Tournament is being canceled, the three competing sensei attend a city council meeting to save it.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3 - Feel The Night
programme.desc: It's Christmastime in the Valley, and romance is in the air. Daniel and Miguel find unexpected common ground, and the Cobra Kai recruits go on a mission.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3 - 43800
programme.desc: Old wounds begin to heal at a country club Christmas party, but a brutal assault by Kreese's students leads to new betrayals and alliances.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4 - Let's Begin
programme.desc: Johnny and Daniel combine dojos but their opposing styles immediately clash. Kreese tries to persuade a former partner to rejoin him at Cobra Kai.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4 - First Learn Stand
programme.desc: Johnny picks up defensive strategies while Daniels learns how to go on the offensive. Amanda confronts Tory. New kid Kenny is bullied at school.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4 - Then Learn Fly
programme.desc: Kenny tries to become a student of Cobra Kai with some encouragement from Robby, while Johnny urges Sam to take a leap of faith - in herself.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4 - Bicephaly
programme.desc: Kreese brings Terry back to Cobra Kai, but his former partner is not interested in repeating history. Johnny grows envious of Daniel mentoring Miguel.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4 - Match Point
programme.desc: Johnny and Daniel's dojo - and their fragile alliance - teeter on the brink of collapse when they agree to a winner-takes-all sensei showdown.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4 - Kicks Get Chicks
programme.desc: A major change to the upcoming tournament sends Johnny scrambling to find a new recruit for Eagle Fang. Tory must ask a favor of the LaRussos.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4 - Minefields
programme.desc: Daniel invites Anthony to join Miyagi-Do and discovers he doesn't know his son as well as he thought. Miguel learns the truth about Johnny and Carmen.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4 - Party Time
programme.desc: Miguel and Sam are excited about attending the junior prom until another couple unexpectedly shows up. Terry lures Johnny to a familiar location.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4 - The Fall
programme.desc: The annual All Valley Karate Tournament kicks off as several competing dojos vie for the grand championship - and settle some personal scores.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4 - The Rise
programme.desc: The tournament comes to a shocking end, with the aftermath leaving its participants reeling - and two champions facing uncertain futures.

programme.title: Cobra Kai - Ace Degenerate
programme.desc: 34 years after losing the All Valley Karate Championship, Johnny Lawrence decides to reopen the Cobra Kai Dojo while his school adversary, Daniel LaRusso, runs a successful auto business.

programme.title: Cobra Kai - Strike First
programme.desc: Daniel is dismayed to find a new Cobra Kai dojo has been opened up. Johnny learns his dojo has to pass several safety requirements before he can actually start teaching.

programme.title: Cobra Kai - Esqueleto
programme.desc: Miguel helps Johnny advertise Cobra Kai on the web. Daniel agrees to chaperon at the Halloween dance so he can keep an eye on his daughter.

programme.title: Cobra Kai - Cobra Kai Never Dies
programme.desc: Robbie is in hot water with his father. Johnny plans to shut down Cobra Kai after Miguel is injured. Samantha and Kyler's relationship hits rock bottom. A vandalized billboard creates tension for Daniel.

programme.title: Cobra Kai - Counterbalance
programme.desc: Cobra Kai gains it's second student. Daniel has an intricate plan to get payback on Johnny. Miguel defends Samantha against Kyler during lunch break.

programme.title: Cobra Kai - Quiver
programme.desc: Johnny's dojo class attracts a group of misfits while his son Robby, who harbors ulterior motives, lands a new job. Samantha makes a new friend in science class. Daniel inspires interest in karate from an unlikely person.

programme.title: Cobra Kai - All Valley
programme.desc: When Johnny learns Cobra Kai is banned from the All Valley Tournament, he faces the City Council. Miguel asks Samantha out. Robbie takes lessons from Daniel, just as his buddies plot a heist from LaRusso Auto.

programme.title: Cobra Kai - Molting
programme.desc: Johnny prepares his Cobra Kai students for the next All Valley Karate Tournament and in turn, he is inspired to clean up his life. Daniel is still unaware of his new pupil's background.

programme.title: The Savvy Nomad Thailand - Chiang Rai

programme.title: Off The Grid India - Majuli 2, Assam

programme.title: Boarding Pass Norway - Roros, Norway

programme.title: Bucket List - Qura
programme.desc: From the swords of the Samurai to hidden Christian churches, Daniel Coll &amp; Paddy Doherty get to know some intriguing sides to Japan.

programme.title: City Breaks - Munich
programme.desc: From palaces to museums, the buildings in Munich are an intriguing mix of traditional Bavarian architecture and avant-garde design.

programme.title: Xplore Austria - Innsbruck

programme.title: The Savvy Nomad Thailand - Koh Tao
programme.desc: Emeline visits Koh Tao - a small island in the Gulf of Thailand often referred to as a ‘diver’s paradise’.

programme.title: Off The Grid India - Bomdila, Arunachal Pradesh
programme.desc: From a festival of warriors to the zombie-proof houses of people, Alex explores the distinctive traditions of the tribes in Arunachal Pradesh.

programme.title: Boarding Pass Norway - Flam, Norway

programme.title: Bucket List - Sakurajima

programme.title: City Breaks - Cologne
programme.desc: Cologne is all things romantic from the chocolate museum to its perfume shop. It is a city in love with life, one that knows how to have a good time.

programme.title: With Love From Mauritius - Episode No. 1
programme.desc: Krisann and Nathan’s vacation in Mauritius begins in Le Morne, where an unexpected adventure awaits the latter.

programme.title: World Spas - Fusion Maia, Vietnam
programme.desc: Jamie Srubis tries spa treatments, which are exclusive at the Fusion Maia resort in Da Nang, Vietnam, such as the Natural Living Massage.

programme.title: Off The Grid India - Tawang, Arunachal Pradesh
programme.desc: From the traditions practiced at a monastery to the simple meals eaten by farmers, Alex experiences Tawang’s harmonious ways of life.

programme.title: Boarding Pass Norway - Oslo, Norway

programme.title: Bucket List - Kagoshima

programme.title: Bliss - Budapest, Hungary

programme.title: Best From The Rest - Peru’s Unique Experiences

programme.title: With Love From Mauritius - Episode No. 2)

programme.title: Heritage - St. Xavier Church

programme.title: Bliss - Baa Atoll, Maldives

programme.title: Happy Ever After - EP34
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: Brick Slaves - EP4
programme.desc: LAU YIU-MING (Vincent Wong) exhausts the money that he and his girlfriend have saved for many years to buy a property and is about to get married. Out of the blue, his girlfriend not only wants to break up with him, but also secretly leases the premises out to a piano teacher, CHOI KIN-CHING (Selena Li). Unfortunately, YIU-MING's bad day gets even worse as he is soon laid off from work.

programme.title: The Runner - EP14
programme.desc: Web media editor Ho Ka-yan (Elaine Yiu) encounters track and field coach Yuen Nik (Joel Chan) as she is assigned the task of approaching the Windchasers Club and digging up scandalous dirt. Because of some past regrettable incident, Yuen Nik avoids socializing with other people. But he is getting closer and closer to Ka-yan as he repeatedly mingles with her. Kwok Bui-yee (Tiffany Lau), daughter of tycoon Kwok Wong-po (Ram Chiang), eagerly joins Windchasers as she has some ulterior motive.

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP40
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: Law dis-Order - EP18
programme.desc: As the founder of the leading Chinese law firm, CHEUK KAI-YIU (Lau Dan) has been re-elected as chairman of the committee for many terms. Though he promised managing partner LAU KING-CHANG (Liu Kai Chi) that he would step down, he deliberately brings in a materialistic lawyer called CHEUNG KEUNG (Alex Fong) to counterbalance KING-CHANG's obsession with power.

programme.title: The Silver Chamber Of Sorrows - EP4
programme.desc: "Sheung’s Silver Chamber", the largest jewel company in Foshan, Guangdong Province China, is facing serious financial difficulties. In order to obtain a loan from SHUM’s family, SHEUNG HANG (Chun Pui), owner of the Chamber, together with his primary wife, CHOI SIU-DIP (Sit Ka Yin), plot to arrange marriage between SHEUNG WAN (Ng Wai Kwok), HANG’s younger brother, and SHUM WING-TUNG (Young Yuen Yee), daughter of SHUM’s family.

programme.title: Hello Missfortune - EP9
programme.desc: In a multidimensional domain, Poon Siu-yu (Erica Chan) enters the second dimension after her death in the first dimension, i.e. the mortal realm. She then joins Office of the Life Authority and becomes a novice "destiny administrator". Siu-yu has to keep a close watch on food courier Chan Pei-ho (Hubert Wu), who is in the mortal realm. Pei-ho earns a meager living regardless of the weather. But his family members just do not care about him.

programme.title: Pages Of Treasures - EP14
programme.desc: Bookshop staff FONG HOK MAN (Chun Pui) always believes that "knowledge is power". He tries hard to encourage his older son FONG SUM MING (Lai Yiu Cheung) and his younger son FONG SUM CHING (Suen Eric) to study more. Unfortunately, MING is not good at studying at all and he quits after secondary school. On the other hand, CHING is a very smart boy and MING works hard overseas to support CHING’s further studies on computer sciences in America.

programme.title: The Legend Of Master Chai - EP7

He was expelled to earth to suffer, while at the same time, he had to help Huen and Nui, who were also sent down to earth, to regain their powers._x000D__x000D_Chai was punished to become the stupid and shabby son, of an earthly man. Huen, on the other hand, was his handsome and clever brother, who was loved by all. One day, Chai regained his magic power and started to challenge Huen.

programme.title: The Legend Of Master Chai - EP8
programme.desc: In Heaven, Chai (Leung Wing Chun) killed Huen (Ho Po Sang) over a pot of sweet lotus seed soup. He was expelled to earth to suffer, while at the same time, he had to help Huen and Nui, who were also sent down to earth, to regain their powers._x000D__x000D_Chai was punished to become the stupid and shabby son, of an earthly man. Huen, on the other hand, was his handsome and clever brother, who was loved by all. One day, Chai regained his magic power and started to challenge Huen.

programme.title: The Silver Chamber Of Sorrows - EP4
programme.desc: "Sheung’s Silver Chamber", the largest jewel company in Foshan, Guangdong Province China, is facing serious financial difficulties. In order to obtain a loan from SHUM’s family, SHEUNG HANG (Chun Pui), owner of the Chamber, together with his primary wife, CHOI SIU-DIP (Sit Ka Yin), plot to arrange marriage between SHEUNG WAN (Ng Wai Kwok), HANG’s younger brother, and SHUM WING-TUNG (Young Yuen Yee), daughter of SHUM’s family.

programme.title: Hello Missfortune - EP9
programme.desc: In a multidimensional domain, Poon Siu-yu (Erica Chan) enters the second dimension after her death in the first dimension, i.e. the mortal realm. She then joins Office of the Life Authority and becomes a novice "destiny administrator". Siu-yu has to keep a close watch on food courier Chan Pei-ho (Hubert Wu), who is in the mortal realm. Pei-ho earns a meager living regardless of the weather. But his family members just do not care about him.

programme.title: Pages Of Treasures - EP14
programme.desc: Bookshop staff FONG HOK MAN (Chun Pui) always believes that "knowledge is power". He tries hard to encourage his older son FONG SUM MING (Lai Yiu Cheung) and his younger son FONG SUM CHING (Suen Eric) to study more. Unfortunately, MING is not good at studying at all and he quits after secondary school. On the other hand, CHING is a very smart boy and MING works hard overseas to support CHING’s further studies on computer sciences in America.

programme.title: 阿叔第17集
programme.desc: 王文钦从小住在嘉义朴子，是当地唯一的「木工家具修复师」，传承老一辈的工匠精神，文钦做事认真，初恋没有开花结果的他，一生未娶，独力抚养姪子姪女。他不仅修复破损的家具，更看见历史的痕迹和故事。而他深切希望修复自己的老家，找回失落的家具，延续家族的回忆。 文钦的初恋情人纪明珠从台北回到嘉义朴子，揭开了文钦不为人知的过去与隐藏的秘密。其后两人开始重新找寻新的情感模式，修复了心中那些被时间模糊的回忆和情感。文钦用他的技艺和爱心，修复人们与自己心中的缺憾，并带来了希望与温暖

programme.title: 热海恋歌第33集
programme.desc: 父母亲早逝的英雄，从小就住在西螺的大舅家。一次乡里冲突，英雄和换帖兄弟添财离家北上，进入温泉乡~北投，当起限时专送的机车小弟。在北投，他遇见今生唯一的挚爱秀秀。拥有天生音乐才华的他，最初学习各种乐器只是为了讨秀秀欢心，最后却因此成为名扬北投的「春风」那卡西乐团乐手。可惜两人纯真的恋情，却遭秀秀的养父所反对，英雄却不放弃；纵使在得知秀秀已与日本商人白原订婚之后，英雄仍不死心，继续穿梭在温泉乡崎岖的巷道与繁华的酒宴间，弹著为秀秀所谱写的未完成歌曲，无畏地向全世界宣誓，他要倾尽一生的光阴来爱秀秀…。在秀秀与白元的婚礼上，英雄冲到美川阁，想带秀秀远走高飞！毕竟深爱著英雄的秀秀，身著婚纱、不顾一切坐上他

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第45集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 大马慈济情第689集
programme.desc: 节目内容为马来西亚当地时事以及慈济人的报导，透过这些具有启发性的报导、爱的讯息，带领观众深入人文道理，见证慈悲等人文知识，进一步带领观众启发善念，净化人心。

programme.title: 法华经序HD中文版第1集

programme.title: 无量义经偈颂第9集
programme.desc:
《无量义经》被誉为《法华经》的前导，也是大乘佛法中最能启发慈悲行的经典。对证严上人而言，这部经是毕生体悟最深的法门，更成为慈济法脉的根本依据。在 上人的带领下，《无量义经》成为慈济人行入人群的实践指南。
本节目以 上人讲解的《无量义经》偈颂为主轴，带领观众把经中智慧用在生活的每个当下，愿人人能从这部经中启发无量善念，为自己与社会带来更多和谐与光亮。

本节目以 上人讲解的《无量义经》偈颂为主轴，带领观众把经中智慧用在生活的每个当下，愿人人能从这部经中启发无量善念，为自己与社会带来更多和谐与光亮。

programme.title: 同学早安第9集
programme.desc: 在家乡玉里服务一辈子的老师「杨招治」 人生幸福组的她却在年过半百时，失去挚爱的丈夫，面临退休与否的抉择。 「人生只能这样吗？」招治问自己。她想起家中的三老，她看见生活周遭需要帮助的灵魂，那些需要触动了招治最温柔的一块心田，她知道，她的人生可以不只是这样…

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第53集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 仁心慧语第200集
programme.desc: 真正的智慧来自于内心，由内心启悟的智慧也最真实。证严 上人说：「做该做的事就是智慧，做不该做的事就是愚痴。」十个问题、十个解方，都是言者生命经验的体现，透过名人的智慧哲理，足以启迪人心，振聋发瞆，重新思考人生的价值。

programme.title: TRY科学第48集
programme.desc: 你我的生活小问号，可能成就科学大发现。所以号召全民try科学，活化每个人潜在的科学基因。 生鸡蛋握掌心，为什么连壮汉都捏不破？！ 一片口香糖，要怎么打开没拉环的易开罐？ 科学基因不限男女老幼贫富贵贱，科学现象不分校园、街头、办公室或客厅，Try科学想戳醒你不找答案不行的好奇心。 Try科学以放大生活中各种有趣现象为诱因，以主持人科学机智问答的闯关设计，透过科学MAN吸引眼球的科学实验与找答案的逻辑推理……让科学接地气，让科学活用在生活里。

programme.title: 蔬果生活志第42集

programme.title: 美好心境界第9集
programme.desc: 单亲妈妈美淑独自带著三个小孩，落脚基隆，在证券公司工作，在股票飞涨的日子里，公司里多余的便当成为美淑和三个小孩渡日果腹的主食。便当岁月日子虽苦，但是，一家人可以依偎在一起，是美淑支撑下去最大的力量。 好姊妹诚懿的丈夫宏业罹患白血病，还没等到配对成功就撒手人寰，却开启美淑进入慈济的大门。一趟花莲寻根列车之旅以后，美淑正式加入培训的队伍。 后来，美淑考上营业员，适逢股市上万点，沉迷在名牌跟美食的欲海中，直到参加水忏共修手语表演，开始她斋戒茹素的生活。 最后，美淑放下二十几年来对前夫的怨怼，把他渡到慈济里来一起奉献，成就他人，也圆满自己。

programme.title: 行动现场第454集
programme.desc:
爱，不漏接，做，就对了！
台湾社会贫富悬殊、强弱失衡，现有政策与资源难以弭平，在国家发展到了一定程度后，最终希望世界大同、人人平等，迈向福利理想国，但社福法规、人力、经费及各方资源都不足分配，无法周全，得靠民间力量自我体现，多少填补缺口。慈济志工为数甚众，是台湾最有组织与规模的NGO，借由众多的人间菩萨散布各乡镇村里，或许能照顾到乏人闻问的黯淡角落。
我们希望提供一个行动平台，让各方NGO团体无论大小，以及无分年纪与工作的爱心公民，参与分工这张绵密的爱心网，网住所有被制度漏接、需要帮助的人。

programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 慈济的故事第42集
programme.desc: 透过证严上人讲述，回溯慈济创立的历史与精神，带您了解慈济的使命与慈悲。

programme.title: 草根菩提第4028集
programme.desc: 有一群人用他们的生活响应 证严上人「用鼓掌双手做环保」的理念；在他们身上，环保居然可以和生活这么地贴近，而不是遥不可及的观念、数字或仪器。这是一群很特别的人，他们无时无刻都在想著如何让我们所住的地球更美好。

programme.title: 大爱真健康第889集
programme.desc: 运动是对自己最好的投资，不只是为了瘦身、增肌，是为了更好的生活品质，每一天做一件对自己好的事，日子就会很踏实。 运动是一辈子的事，没时间运动不是借口，每天花三~五分钟时间，跟著「大爱真健康」做运动，让你愈动愈年轻、愈动愈健康！

programme.title: 大爱午安新闻 LIVE

programme.title: 志为人医守护爱2.0第183集
programme.desc:
什么是有温度的医疗？什么是医疗之魂？医疗团队除了在诊间、在手术室、在病房抢救生命之外，还能做些什么？
『志为人医守护爱』带您目击动人的温馨医病情现场，透过医疗团队的视病如亲、 以病为师的坚持、病患与医疗团队的互相感恩，体会与感受现代人医如何帮助病患重拾信心，在他们人生低潮时重新出发，进而走入人群，自助助人。

programme.title: 行动现场第548集
programme.desc:
爱，不漏接，做，就对了！
台湾社会贫富悬殊、强弱失衡，现有政策与资源难以弭平，在国家发展到了一定程度后，最终希望世界大同、人人平等，迈向福利理想国，但社福法规、人力、经费及各方资源都不足分配，无法周全，得靠民间力量自我体现，多少填补缺口。慈济志工为数甚众，是台湾最有组织与规模的NGO，借由众多的人间菩萨散布各乡镇村里，或许能照顾到乏人闻问的黯淡角落。
我们希望提供一个行动平台，让各方NGO团体无论大小，以及无分年纪与工作的爱心公民，参与分工这张绵密的爱心网，网住所有被制度漏接、需要帮助的人。

programme.title: 美好心境界第9集
programme.desc: 单亲妈妈美淑独自带著三个小孩，落脚基隆，在证券公司工作，在股票飞涨的日子里，公司里多余的便当成为美淑和三个小孩渡日果腹的主食。便当岁月日子虽苦，但是，一家人可以依偎在一起，是美淑支撑下去最大的力量。 好姊妹诚懿的丈夫宏业罹患白血病，还没等到配对成功就撒手人寰，却开启美淑进入慈济的大门。一趟花莲寻根列车之旅以后，美淑正式加入培训的队伍。 后来，美淑考上营业员，适逢股市上万点，沉迷在名牌跟美食的欲海中，直到参加水忏共修手语表演，开始她斋戒茹素的生活。 最后，美淑放下二十几年来对前夫的怨怼，把他渡到慈济里来一起奉献，成就他人，也圆满自己。

programme.desc: 印尼，是个超过两亿人口的东南亚大国，贫富差距极大，且语言文化种族差异均大。由印尼大爱台制作的「映照人生」，报导当地各面向的社会议题，从2010年起逐年获奖，被誉为是印尼正面纪录片的先驱之一。 制作团队都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地观点，对印尼社会做深度观察，发现问题，报导当事人如何解决或面对，制作出一系列感人且启发人心的故事，传达以人道为关怀精神的节目内容。 本节目记录著印尼底层的人们，每个勇敢迎向苦难与希望的故事；也带领观众看见，这个世界的黑暗角落，因为人性的光辉，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 庆余年第9集
programme.desc: 某大学文学史专业的学生张庆（张若昀饰）熟读古典名著，但他用现代观念剖析古代文学史，透过写小说的方式，进一步阐述自己想要表达的观点。在他的小说中，身世神秘的少年范闲，自小跟随奶奶生活在海边小城澹州，随著一位自称老师的突然造访，他看似平静的生活开始直面重重的危机与考验。上半部的剧情主要发生在京都，范闲追查牛栏街刺杀一案的幕后黑手。下半部剧情发生在北齐上京城，范闲亲率南庆使团，前往北齐用战犯肖恩交换言冰云。但这只是，庆帝和陈萍萍布局，想令肖恩误以为范闲就是他失散多年的孙子，借此套出神庙的秘密。

programme.title: MIT台湾志第623集
programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陆寻奇第1938集
programme.desc: 大陆寻奇是台湾目前最社教节目之冠不惜巨资的大制作足迹踏遍各现代城市、穷乡僻壤，深入各民族村落，记录了外人难得一见的生活情况，以准确的地理、历史定位，用现代化思维，把中华文化忠实的呈现。 漫游在浩瀚中国的世外桃源，细赏湖光山色间的粉妆玉琢，带您跋山涉水游遍奇峰峻岭，让您看尽壮阔山河叹为观止。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子第6季:第408集
programme.desc: 本作品是以作者的童年（昭和49年，即1974年）生活为蓝本的故事，其中一事一物均充满著1970年代的怀旧气息。故事发生的舞台是日本静冈县清水市，那是一个不折不扣的美丽港都，是个交通便利、渔产丰富、又与富士山为邻的好地方。故事围绕著小丸子以及其家人和同学展开，有关于亲情、友谊等，或是一些生活小事，但当中有笑有泪，令人回想起童年的稚气。

programme.title: 唱歌给你听第44集
programme.desc: 故事讲述一个在台湾北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父亲不切实际地为这个家带来债务、困扰与纷争。时常失踪的父亲只能由任劳任怨的母亲咬牙把这个家支撑下去。多年后四处飘浪的父亲癌末回来找长大后的女儿，女儿为了处理父亲的临终把本已瓦解的家庭关系，再次找回分散各地家人，并在父亲临终前相互道歉、和解道别。

programme.title: 倚天屠龙记第4集
programme.desc: 元朝末年，屠龙宝刀再现江湖，武林各派你争我夺，激起一场腥风血雨！武当派张翠山与天鹰教殷素素因屠龙刀而相识、相恋，成亲生子，也因屠龙刀而丧命，留下孤儿张无忌。张无忌少年奇遇，修炼九阳神功有成！因祸得福，习乾坤大挪移脱险！拯救明教灭教之祸，被推举为教主！排解六大派纷争，誓死对抗蒙古人！。同时，蒙古郡主赵敏、峨嵋派周芷若、表妹殷离、波斯少女小昭对他的倾慕，让他不知所措，陷入情仇不分，爱中有恨的窘境………. lt;br/> lt;br/>主要演员lt;br/>曾舜晞 饰 张无忌lt;br/>陈钰琪 饰 赵 敏lt;br/>祝绪丹 饰 周芷若lt;br/>周海媚 饰 灭绝师太lt;br/>黑 子 饰 金毛狮王 谢 逊lt;br/>许雅

programme.desc: 《新霹雳英雄榜》是一部动作冒险类型的电视剧或电影系列，为霹雳布袋戏的新一代作品。故事背景设定在一个神秘的武林世界，充满了武术、魔法和神秘力量。故事围绕著一群英雄人物展开，他们各自拥有独特的技能和身世背景。他们将面临来自黑暗势力和邪恶组织的威胁，必须团结一致，通过战斗和冒险来守护正义和保护世界的平衡。《新霹雳英雄榜》融合了激烈的打斗场面、刺激的动作场景和细腻的角色发展，带给观众一场震撼的视觉盛宴。剧情扣人心弦，充满著惊险、奇幻和神秘的元素，同时也融入了人物之间的情感和义务的探讨。这部作品以霹雳布袋戏的独特风格和特色为基础，结合了现代特效和技术，将传统和现代元素相结合，呈现出一个全新的霹雳世界。观

programme.title: 包青天第26集
programme.desc: 包拯为北宋仁宗天圣五年（1027年）申科进士甲科，初任建昌知县，官至开封府尹及龙图阁大学士，这跟电视上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中国清官的典型代表，后世包括朱熹、欧阳修、司马光对他都有正面评价。宋仁宗年间，开封府尹包拯，通称「包青天」。为官清廉，为民伸冤，强调「人在做天在看」、「举头三尺有神明」不畏强权，除恶务尽。较脍炙人口的单元有「秦香莲」、「真假状元」、「貍猫换太子」等。

programme.desc: 《当昼新闻》是一个日间新闻节目，提供即时、全面的国内外新闻报导，涵盖政治、经济、社会、文化等多方面的重要议题。这个节目专注于在白天时段向观众传递当下最重要的新闻资讯，让观众随时掌握时事动向，并对众多议题保持关注和理解。无论是政治动荡、经济变化，或者社会事件和文化创新，这个节目都将为观众带来最及时的报导和解析。

programme.title: 客客客栈第9集
programme.desc: 提到「客家」，你会联想到什么？硬颈精神、勤劳节俭、客家美食，还是满天飞舞的桐花？而「客家」，又是怎么来的呢？又有什么样有趣的小故事？

programme.title: 电视音乐专辑第34集
programme.desc: 客家音乐已走入了台湾Live Music的展演殿堂，我们希望这样的音乐热度，能在客家电视呈现。因此，节目以「电视演唱会」的形式，一集聚焦一位客家歌手，针对每一位歌手的特性，量身打造出其巨星光芒，以这样一步一脚印的方式，累积出一集集精彩的声光演出。

programme.title: 拉拉杂杂有土伯第1集

programme.title: 闹热打擂台第508集

programme.title: 暗夜新闻第59集
programme.desc: 暗夜客话新闻是全国唯一主播、记者以全客语发音的新闻频道，并 详实显示字幕，除了著眼于「客家观点」的重要新闻议题、呈现客家生活 习俗与传统文化之外，更尽力发掘社会各阶层客家乡亲的故事。暗夜客话新闻针对四节新闻播出镜面，以桐花、蓝衫等各种不同主题的客家元素为基础，作全面的视觉设计，让收视大众们能够耳目一新、零时差的掌握，最具客家观点的新闻呈现。

programme.title: 小O事件簿第168集

programme.title: 工程大改造第8集

programme.title: 理查哈蒙玩很大第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 本集节目将带观众探访美军的巨无霸超级银河运输机；雄伟的C-5M超级银河运输机，几乎可以容纳军方所需的所有东西，帮忙把军备或人道救援物资运送到世界各地。但让这么庞大的飞机平稳地在空中飞行，必须掌握许多诀窍，例如飞行前务必计算货舱重心，因为每次载货的重心都会改变，若重心偏移运输机可能就会飞不起来，甚至还会严重影响飞安。此外，即使是这么大的运输机，偶尔还是可能遇到燃料不足的情况，这时就需要加油机前来支援，执行惊险的空中加油任务，这可是非常考验驾驶飞行能力的时刻。

programme.title: 理查哈蒙玩很大第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 本集节目这回来到奥地利，探访巨无霸的柯恩布莱茵大坝。它是全球最大的水坝之一，储水量高达两亿公吨，最神奇的是它仅靠一片单薄的围墙，就能挡住如此大量的储水。工程师将这道一百九十公尺高的围墙设计成优雅的拱形，如此一来，不仅成功把水压转移到两侧的山峦，还大量减少了用来建造围墙的水泥；此外，柯恩布莱茵大坝也是全球最大的水力发电大坝之一，储水奔流二十二公里，来到河谷下方一千公尺的发电厂后，再经过涡轮机和变压器转化，在这里产生的电力就能供应全奥地利，甚至还能透过电网送电到德国或义大利。

programme.title: 绝地伐木勇士第2季:第6集
programme.desc: 自古以来，伐木一直是人类生活的重要产业，时至今日，仍是世界上最危险的工作之一。树越大，风险越高...报酬也越可观。在太平洋西北地区，伐木工杰瑞德道格拉斯带著团队，采伐世界上最巨大、最有价值的树种之一：北美桧木。但要把这些体积跟巴士一样大的巨木，从森林运送到市场一点也不容易。不仅需要高超的锯木功夫、规模庞大的机械设备，还要有在地表最严酷环境上工的勇气。

programme.desc: 佛莱迪和璜前往爱达荷州，尝试帮助三名年轻矿工转亏为盈，尤其是三个家庭的所有希望都寄托在这项采矿作业上。

programme.title: 绝地伐木勇士第2季:第6集
programme.desc: 自古以来，伐木一直是人类生活的重要产业，时至今日，仍是世界上最危险的工作之一。树越大，风险越高...报酬也越可观。在太平洋西北地区，伐木工杰瑞德道格拉斯带著团队，采伐世界上最巨大、最有价值的树种之一：北美桧木。但要把这些体积跟巴士一样大的巨木，从森林运送到市场一点也不容易。不仅需要高超的锯木功夫、规模庞大的机械设备，还要有在地表最严酷环境上工的勇气。

programme.title: 旧货猎人-翻新乔治时期古宅第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 德鲁普里察卖掉所有财产，并把换来的资金全部用来翻修有230年历史的乔治时期联排屋。

programme.title: 旧矿区新财路第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 科罗拉多州明溪郡的可怜人矿场以产银矿为主，矿场主戴夫莫许请艾利克斯和凯文来改善矿坑内的通风以及霉菌问题，并且将一辆老旧向车整修改装成办公室。两人除了可以连续五年获得产出的百分之五，同时还收到重达2.7公斤的银条。

programme.title: 翻新中古车第12季:第5集
programme.desc: 这回麦克要寻找1970年代生产的古怪汽车，AMC佩瑟，最后在圣荷西便宜买到。艾德为这款怪车设计出独一无二的包膜设计,最后却不得麦克的欢心。

programme.title: 亚当的超狂工作室第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 本集节目，亚当找来了老朋友托瑞贝勒奇合作。两人将绞尽脑汁，构想并打造各式机器，目的无他，只为来一场超级食物大战。究竟谁会获胜呢？敬请锁定。

programme.title: 美洲大地第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 带领观众探索美洲这片地球最大的陆地：唯一横跨南北两极的广阔大陆。透过鲜为人知的非凡野生动物故事，揭开壮丽景观背后的秘密与脆弱，牵动全世界的心

programme.title: 美洲大地第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 带领观众探索美洲这片地球最大的陆地：唯一横跨南北两极的广阔大陆。透过鲜为人知的非凡野生动物故事，揭开壮丽景观背后的秘密与脆弱，牵动全世界的心

programme.title: 富豪谷底求翻身-东山再起第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 布莱恩是黑带6段的好手，他的全职工作是担任宾州员警，而过去15年来，他都志在帮助清贫孩童，在自己开的道馆里指导他们练空手道。然而受疫情封城影响，布莱恩的场馆入不敷出，面临倒闭危机，他希望葛伦能为他指引经营之道，让这项事业开始赚钱，这样才能帮助到更多人。布莱恩能成功将这份兴趣转变成事业吗？

programme.title: 富豪谷底求翻身-东山再起第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 葛伦回到伊利后，帮助了许多当地的事业起死回生，而他要抢救的最后一间公司，就是他自己一年前所创的小卒烧烤。受疫情影响再加上内部管理不当，小卒烧烤的营收不断大幅下滑；这样的惨况，让葛伦的连锁餐饮美梦越来越遥远，甚至动起了卖掉餐厅的念头。还留在小卒的老班底艾胥利，有办法通过层层考验与巨大压力，成功在葛伦的带领之下杀出重围吗？还是伊利要和这个美国梦的代表说再见了？

programme.title: 仓储挖宝王第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 艾伦海夫和汤琼斯在洛杉矶竞标仓库很多年了，但圣圣佛南多谷是艾伦第一次踏入此行的地方，当地的仓储竞标生意非常竞争，竞标者全是个中高手。

programme.title: 仓储挖宝王第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 西亚当斯是全洛杉矶历史最悠久的社区，汤和艾伦这一天只带了1千美元，顺利以不到1千美元标下3个仓库。

programme.title: 星座情人第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 牡羊女泰勒再也无法跟杰克共处一室，两人甚至分房睡，因此占星师决定顺从泰勒的意愿让她离开实验，这也让庄园里的大家感到震惊。不过，占星师也给了愿意投入实验的杰克第二次机会，再度为他找来天秤座的贝丝，希望两人能看对眼。同时，艾希力摸不透马谛亚的心意，两人似乎只有亲密关系的连结，这样的关系会长久吗？

programme.title: 秘境厨房第2季:第2集
programme.desc: 秘境厨房再次开张，本周艾琳要挑战从未用过的食材，还要从有限的农作选择中，做出同样让顾客惊艳的美味晚餐。艾琳首先去体验了海钓鲭鱼，因为她决定使用鲭鱼做料理，但她没料理过鲭鱼，只好和员工一起脑力激荡，最后利用面包做出一道美味的鲭鱼开味菜。沙拉和甜点的部分则使用夏季第一批收成的美味草莓，然而甜点的司康在准备时出了大纰漏，艾琳只能绷紧神经重做新的，并且努力不把紧张的情绪散播给其他人。

programme.title: 我的梦幻婚纱第17季:第8集
programme.desc: 蓝迪带著他的婚纱系列到巴塞隆纳参加世上最大的婚纱展览会，他还办了婚纱秀。雀喜深深喜爱海莉佩姬的婚纱，她最想试穿的是其中的佩普婚纱，然而佩普婚纱突然不见踪影，黛安好不容易才找到，她还给雀喜惊喜，把海莉佩姬本人请到克莱菲尔跟雀喜见面。雪柔跟未婚夫大卫大老远从香港来到克莱菲尔寻找婚纱，大卫向雪柔求婚三次，丽莎觉得自己责任重大。

programme.title: 脚痛要人命-线上看诊第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 新冠肺炎疫情肆虐全球，世界仿佛都静止下来了，但医学可不会停下脚步。尽管大家都待在家里与外界隔离，但脚痛起来简直要人命，患者更不可能得以隔离疼痛，幸好靠著线上看诊，足踝外科医师依然能与病患取得联系，检查患者的足部病症。老雷在多年前发生过一场严重车祸，导致他脚踝的骨头全部碎裂，医生当时把珊瑚礁磨成粉后掺杂血液调和出一种凝胶，硬化后就可以作为骨替代物，但多年下来，他的脚踝变形越来越严重，几乎整个向内弯折，让他只能一跛一跛地行走。艾波妮医师认为可以再做一次股骨移植术，重建他的脚踝。

programme.title: 脚痛要人命-线上看诊第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 新冠肺炎疫情肆虐全球，世界仿佛都静止下来了，但医学可不会停下脚步。尽管大家都待在家里与外界隔离，但脚痛起来简直要人命，患者更不可能得以隔离疼痛，幸好靠著线上看诊，足踝外科医师依然能与病患取得联系，检查患者的足部病症。今年十四岁的特洛伊有罕见的第六根脚趾，当初他一生下来，妈妈还以为这根脚趾是幸运的象征，没想到随著孩子长大，幸运脚趾却成了一场恶梦，因为特洛伊根本找不到合脚的鞋子，只能勉强穿上楦头超宽的大号女鞋，这对青少年来说心理可真不好过，但好在特洛伊生性乐天，能以幽默方式看待自己的先天畸形，艾波妮医师也被他们母子档逗得笑哈哈。

programme.title: 从里到外第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 这次麦可和卡麦恩要著手改造工匠式风格的房屋，除了室内的格局要大幅更动外，室外也有大量的空间要修整，究竟他们该如何分配并守住预算，为屋主打造充满自然风格的家？

programme.title: 小镇翻修趣振兴全美第2季:第2集
programme.desc: 本集团队拜访了摩根堡的义消奥登和他的母亲胡安妮塔，为这对致力回馈社区的母子改造房子。

programme.title: 超级大体型第2季:第6集
programme.desc: 在减肥外科普罗克特医生的协助下，病态性肥胖患者为自己的生命奋战。家庭关系、友谊都备受考验，唯有少数人会做出真正的改变，进行减重手术来开启新的人生道路。

programme.desc: 在本集节目中，主持人克莉丝汀娜带著亲朋好友来到田纳西州，她将帮助凯文和凯蒂把它们的义式旧房改造成现代农庄屋。由于这次的屋主有丰富的翻修经验，所以很多地方都由他们自行施工。让我们看看这次的团队合作会迸出什么样的新火花吧。

programme.title: 秘境厨房第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 本周的食材清单终于变得比较丰富，艾琳因此非常兴奋，她等不及要利用各种食材做出让客人们永生难忘的一顿晚餐。由于前一周的甜点司康出了差错，导致艾琳的神经紧绷到晚餐的最后一刻，这个星期她决定列出更详细的准备工作清单，并且让其他人帮忙分担甜点研发的工作。最后在大家的同心协力之下，秘境厨房的团队终于找回久违的默契和节奏感，完成一次漂亮的晚餐招待，建立起面对未来的信心。

programme.desc: 年近四十的单亲妈妈露易丝自认终于找到真爱，准备前往哥伦比亚跟小她十岁的男友荷西结婚，但两人却是第一次见面，这让亲友十分担心。

programme.title: 迷你屋大梦想第8季:第8集
programme.desc: 怀抱童心的杰西和布兰妲夫妇为两个女儿打造了一间异想天开的航海主题迷你屋，里面不仅有超好玩的爬行隧道可以连接孩子和爸妈的房间，屋顶还装了一支风车为杰西所设计的迷你气象观测装置供电。这对爸妈在屋内设计了非常多巧思，就连存放散装食物的方式也十分别出心裁。

programme.title: 我的梦幻婚纱第17季:第9集
programme.desc: 凯西蒂一心想买海莉佩姬设计的海莉婚纱，但她四处都找不找，最后她上IG发简讯给海莉，海莉回复建议她去克莱菲尔，然而克莱菲尔还是没有她的尺寸，他们只好打给海莉向海莉求助，正好海莉有一件尺寸正确的海莉婚纱，为了给凯西蒂惊喜，海莉立刻拿著这件婚纱跳上计程车来到克莱菲尔。

programme.title: 好屋重生记第5季:第4集
programme.desc: 米娜和凯伦这对母女档这次要翻修一间过去曾是骑士酒吧的房子，房子只有14坪，没有卧室只有一间卫浴，所以她们要在后面增建一栋两层楼的楼房，好让这栋房子可以成为让家庭安居乐业的好房，不过这次增建工程有点大，能不能顺利完成，并卖出好价格呢？

programme.title: 到国外征婚去第1季:第9集
programme.desc: 丝丹妮卡跟诺乐丁的家人见面了，原本一切顺利，她却在吃饭的时候表现出不喜欢招待饮品的表情。

programme.title: 海滩生活不插电第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 来自德州达拉斯的葛雷格带著好友露丝来加拿大卑诗省寻找一栋度假房屋，预算为200万美金，房仲雪琳带著他们看了三栋房产，乘坐游艇前往的崖边天堂，有三栋建筑的隐居岛以及有私人沙滩的隐藏宝藏，最后葛雷格选择隐藏宝藏，并以150万美金成功买下。

programme.title: 海滩生活不插电第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 自从罗素和玛丽安多年前到万那杜度假后，就对这美丽的太平洋岛国念念不忘，现在两人决定要在万那杜买一个自己的家。房仲华伦根据他们开出的条件找了不少好房子，当中的选择甚至包括一座岛。或许两人成为小岛主人的愿望能在万那杜成真。

programme.title: 时人杂志犯罪调查第4季:第2集
programme.desc: 罗伦森莱特原是深受欢迎的美国职篮球星，被称为曼菲斯之子。罗伦森娶了心爱的女人，也和妻子生下六个小孩，实现他想要大家庭的梦想，但一切并不如表象那般完美。多年下来，他为了球赛不停奔波，让家庭生活出现了裂痕，最后以离婚收场。罗伦森是好父亲，离婚后仍会常常去看孩子，某天他正在陪儿子时接到神秘电话，出了门后就再也没回家。等警方找到他时，罗伦森已经成了尸体，而且严重腐烂，已无法提供什么有助调查的线索，等于一开始就成了悬案……

programme.title: 面子问题第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 洛杉矶有一群顶尖外科医师，进行世界上最复杂的颜面重建手术。他们运用精湛医术，为饱受严重畸形与罕见疾病折磨的患者，重拾尊严、点燃希望，开启人生新篇章。

programme.title: 秘境厨房第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 本周的食材清单终于变得比较丰富，艾琳因此非常兴奋，她等不及要利用各种食材做出让客人们永生难忘的一顿晚餐。由于前一周的甜点司康出了差错，导致艾琳的神经紧绷到晚餐的最后一刻，这个星期她决定列出更详细的准备工作清单，并且让其他人帮忙分担甜点研发的工作。最后在大家的同心协力之下，秘境厨房的团队终于找回久违的默契和节奏感，完成一次漂亮的晚餐招待，建立起面对未来的信心。

programme.title: 我的梦幻婚纱第17季:第9集
programme.desc: 凯西蒂一心想买海莉佩姬设计的海莉婚纱，但她四处都找不找，最后她上IG发简讯给海莉，海莉回复建议她去克莱菲尔，然而克莱菲尔还是没有她的尺寸，他们只好打给海莉向海莉求助，正好海莉有一件尺寸正确的海莉婚纱，为了给凯西蒂惊喜，海莉立刻拿著这件婚纱跳上计程车来到克莱菲尔。

programme.title: 装修首购屋第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 设计师兼包商夫妻党，善用低成本设计巧思，加上屋主自己的亲力亲为，协助首购族把第一个家打造成令人惊艳的理想空间，同时牢牢守住预算底线。

programme.title: 凶杀诱惑第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 世界上有一群人，会唆使身边的人犯下谋杀罪行，许多案例中，搧风点火的背后指使者，操控深爱他们的人，进而借刀杀人。他们无所不用其极，用爱情、性、金钱，或是赤裸裸的欺骗，来得到他们想要的东西...

programme.title: 海滩生活不插电第1季:第5集

programme.title: 食材探源第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 凯蒂伯顿为了进一步了解海鲜如何从水里捕捞上岸，亲自跟著渔船一起出海捕鱼，然后利用简单的调味和料理方式，烹调出食材的新鲜和美味。

programme.title: 食材探源第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 名厨凯蒂伯顿热爱乳酪，也知道怎么料理乳酪，但就是不会制作乳酪，而这趟乳品农庄之旅，不仅让她深入乳酪制作现场，学会简单在自家做乳酪，更让她看到背后所投注的热情。

programme.desc: 凯莉与杰森前往贝里斯寻找他们的梦幻不插电住家，房仲克里斯带他们参观滨海双住家，丛林三层楼住家跟贝里斯风格海滩小屋，最后他们选择面积跟设计都合乎条件的滨海双住家。

programme.title: 海滩生活不插电第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 本集的寻屋人是一对经营钓鱼与潜水事业的夫妻，他们想要带著孩子前来大溪地寻找一处远离城市喧嚣、亲近海边的不插电天堂，他们是否能用理想的价格，寻得一个宽敞明亮的完美住处，甚至是拥有一座自己的私人小岛呢？

programme.title: 小镇翻修趣振兴全美第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 威屯卡小镇的振兴计划终于进入最终阶段，班和艾琳只剩下最后一栋房子要翻修，这是全镇最古老的宅邸之一，也有许多棘手的问题需要解决。

programme.title: 亚洲好住家第8季:第11集
programme.desc: 来自佛罗里达州的大学教授盖瑞与瑞贝卡夫妇因为参与海上学府计划，深深被越南所吸引，在孩子长大之后决定放弃终身职，移居越南生活。

programme.title: 亚洲好住家第8季:第12集

programme.title: 小镇翻修趣振兴全美第2季:第2集

programme.title: 六千金在我家第5季:第11集
programme.desc: 布蕾克犬齿长歪了，夫妻俩人要带布蕾克去拔牙；五胞胎学校办感恩节大餐活动，丹妮尔需要在家陪五胞胎练习说出感恩之情。

programme.title: 星座情人第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 马谛亚几经思量后，忍不住对杰克与贝丝坦承对艾希力实在没感觉，然而由于大家都知道他们两人已经发展过亲密关系，这也让马谛亚有点不知如何开口，艾希力也不免感到沮丧。占星师了解状况之后认为，由于两人已经一同走过一段完整的感情历程，他们的实验只能到此为止。其他伴侣得知消息后都感到非常震惊，但这也表示庄园有空间再容纳两位新成员了，这两人又会与谁配对呢？

programme.title: 面子问题第1季:第4集

programme.desc: 布朗克斯动物园饲养了一对扬子鳄。今天是扬子鳄繁殖计划展开的第一年。

programme.title: 核灾过后车诺比
programme.desc: 人类学家玛莉安欧哈塔和生物学家罗伯尼尔森取得特殊许可，在车诺比核灾发生30年后重回禁区，一探辐射污染对当地生物的影响。他们发现当地的辐射污染在多年后依然相当严重，如果待太久会有致命之虞，不过大自然逐渐复苏，虽然辐射对某些生物造成严重的伤害，导致突变，影响繁殖能力，可是生物也演化出适应环境的能力。

programme.title: 百变爬虫箱第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 克莉丝汀养了三只大球蟒。她觉得每只球蟒都有不同的个性，加上自己又喜欢迪士尼电影，因此请葛雷格和他的团队，帮他设计迪士尼电影主题的三个爬虫箱，分别是白雪公主风格、泰山风格和小美人鱼风格。葛雷去请教熟知迪士尼电影的女儿爱玛。爱玛建议了爬虫箱里必备的重要元素，如白雪公主箱里要有魔镜和玻璃棺材；泰山风格可换成森林王子风格，做出可攀爬的树籐；小美人鱼箱则可做出水底渐层。这整套设计让克莉丝汀看得开心得不得了。

programme.title: 苏格兰-守护野生动物第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 多娜面对身上长满蛆的羊，必须采取不得已的办法减轻牠的痛苦。安迪设法围捕几只脱逃的宠物鼠。约翰应付一只紧张激动的牧羊犬，苦劝饲主交出牠。

programme.title: 百变爬虫箱第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 一家刺青店的夫妻，由于长时间待在店里，所以希望把家里的公蚺和母蚺带来店里养，接著索性想请康乃尔世界帮他们打造两个抢眼的爬虫箱，一个在柜台下面，让每个顾客进门都可以看到抢眼的公巨蚺；另一个大爬虫箱放在等候坐位区，让顾客可以在自拍时，拿巨蚺当背景。康乃尔在柜台前设计的爬虫箱里面，放了日本武士刀，模拟自然栖地的树木，让公蚺可以在上面爬。另一个爬虫箱则设计成日式宝塔，里面放树枝拼出大的大树，背景是鲜艳的风格，映衬出白子母蚺的形态。这两个爬虫箱令刺青店夫妻和顾客都赞不绝口。

programme.title: 非洲的夜间猎手
programme.desc: 24小时并不长，但光是在同一天里，我们的世界就有巨大变化。有些动物起床时，另一些动物正准备入睡；有些地方正值夏季的漫长白昼；有些地方却面对著冬季的无尽黑暗；当半个地球接受著阳光的温暖，另外半个地球则沐浴在月光里。跟著今天的节目，窥看短短一天中，地球万物如何不停变动。

programme.title: 中国野生秘境第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 由英国国宝级演员担纲旁白，这部野生动物系列带你走进中国隐秘的自然保护区，掀开罕见奇特生物的神秘面纱。

programme.title: 动物奇门功夫第1季:第29集
programme.desc: 本集节目介绍各种动物的奇门功夫。为什么牛总是嚼个不停？犀牛有敏感纤细的一面吗？被响尾蛇一咬，为什么逃得走却仍躲不了？哪种动物的鼻子最古怪？

programme.title: 动物奇门功夫第1季:第30集
programme.desc: 本集节目介绍各种动物的奇门功夫。海马为什么坚不可摧？狗为什么要埋东西？大象能侦测炸弹吗？海狮的须有什么用处？为什么鸟早上歌声最嘹亮？

programme.title: 神秘动物大追踪第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 野生动物学家佛瑞斯特葛兰特在世界各地寻觅神秘动物的踪迹，试图揭开牠们的神秘面纱，并解开人与动物之间的误会。这次他来到秘鲁的偏远农村，据说来自地狱的恶魔正在骚扰平民，他们设下重重机关，终于亲眼目睹这一身黑毛的人形怪兽…

programme.title: 超能动物第2季:第8集
programme.desc: 《超能动物》探索栖息在地球上奇妙又惊人的生物。每一集主题透过震撼的大自然影像、漫画风格的视觉效果，搭配不可思议的小知识，展现这些不同凡响的动物，巧妙结合自然历史与流行文化，寓教于乐，适合所有年龄层的观众一同观赏。

programme.title: 超能动物第2季:第7集
programme.desc: 《超能动物》探索栖息在地球上奇妙又惊人的生物。每一集主题透过震撼的大自然影像、漫画风格的视觉效果，搭配不可思议的小知识，展现这些不同凡响的动物，巧妙结合自然历史与流行文化，寓教于乐，适合所有年龄层的观众一同观赏。

programme.title: 印度塔尔大沙漠第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 塔尔大沙漠位于印度，绵延约2万7千公里，环境干旱恶劣，生物难以生存。但这里却也是世界上最多人居住的沙漠。两千多年来都是重要的贸易路线，连接印度,西亚,欧洲和中国，因此仍有城市坐落其间。看似荒芜的沙漠也潜藏无限生机，黑鸢、雨燕、蓑羽鹤、印度黑羚、刺猬和蛇，各种沙漠生物自有适应之道，人类也一样，一面适应环境，一面逐步迈向现代的挑战。

programme.title: 路易斯安纳保育战第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 在圣伯纳德堂区，未购买咸水钓鱼证的钓客配合查验，主动缴出自己钓起过最大的海鳟。未依规定穿救生衣的钓客配合安检，获得警告单处分。在韦伯斯特堂区基萨奇国家森林，猎鹿人未带标签被识破，因为没有移动过鹿，仅对未带标签开罚。在圣玛丽堂区阿察法来雅三角洲，未成年人违法在行进中的船上开枪射小水鸭，船上另两名成年人被以促成未成年人犯罪一并开罚。在杰弗孙堂区威斯特威哥运河，受查验的船恪守法友善，令野生动物干员愉快。在波西尔堂区，野生动物干员送给有穿救生衣的小女孩写著我被抓到穿著救生衣的T恤做奖励。在卡尔克苏堂区，河边居民无视标志，违反禁扬尾波区的规定。在温恩堂区，地主以言语阻止猎人打猎，被指控骚扰猎人。

programme.title: 野性之海第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 泰国的珊瑚礁有八成遭到破坏，有些岛上甚至因为过度旅游破坏了生态系。

programme.title: 动物奇门功夫第1季:第29集

programme.title: 河中巨怪-谜样水域第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 最近太平洋北端发生了怪事，那里出现许多不该出现的鱼，原本位于亚热带的鱼在阿拉斯加现踪，而本来在阿拉斯加的大比目鱼却消失了。

programme.title: 灭绝动物大追踪第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 野生生物学家佛瑞斯特葛兰特前往辛巴威，重回他儿时的家园，并前往保育区寻找传说中的开普狮。

programme.title: 苏格兰-守护野生动物第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 有只狗被发现绑在路边护栏，后来咬断系绳躲进工地。瓶鼻鲸是深海物种，却异常出现在湖中。民众在农场发现小刺猬，母亲不在牠身边。

programme.title: 中国野生秘境第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 由英国国宝级演员担纲旁白，这部野生动物系列带你走进中国隐秘的自然保护区，掀开罕见奇特生物的神秘面纱。

programme.title: 炙热非洲第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 在炙热的非洲，动物必须苦苦挣扎才能躲过死亡和灭绝，豺犬坚韧又能吃苦，但豺犬数量大幅减少，可能失去最强掠食者的地位。

programme.title: 动物百分百第3季:第3集
programme.desc: 鹦鹉种类超过350种，住在各式各样的栖地，色彩鲜艳，喜欢社交又喧闹，在牠们居住的生态系扮演重要角色。

programme.title: 与狮群相伴第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 在非洲的莽原上，驻扎在马拉河岸的荷黑亚莱桑柯奇与狮群为伴，深入观察狮群的生活，而狮群也逐渐习惯他的存在。

programme.title: 猎杀倒数第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 北美洲的恶劣天气，加上无情的地貌，即使是最强大的动物，也为了适应环境被逼迫到极限。

programme.title: 自然怪事求解答第1季:第23集
programme.desc: 义大利摄影师罗伯托毕昂凯帝使用无人机拍摄山间风景的时候，在辛基诺水坝的墙面上发现了一些奇怪的斑点。

programme.title: 自然怪事求解答第1季:第24集
programme.desc: 速度超快的猎豹打猎成功机率只有58%，而且还时常在追捕的过程中半途而废，为什么会这样？

programme.title: 野性拉丁美洲第1季:第9集
programme.desc: 安地斯山是世界上最长的山脉，山林风貌更是变化多端，除了有最原始的丛林，还有永远覆盖著白雪的山峰，栖息在这里的动物也更是一群奇妙的生物。翱翔山峰之间的康多兀鹫是世上体型最大的陆栖性鸟类，可以靠著庞大无比的翅膀乘著山峰间的气流滑翔。外表逗趣的眼镜熊也是安地斯山最出名的珍禽异兽，牠会出没在安地斯山的各个地区，足迹甚至遍及海拔三千多公尺的地方。有著吓人样貌的的的喀喀湖水蛙也很特别，牠可是少数会照顾蛙卵的蛙类，保护蛙卵在孵化前能安然无恙。

programme.title: 核灾过后车诺比
programme.desc: 人类学家玛莉安欧哈塔和生物学家罗伯尼尔森取得特殊许可，在车诺比核灾发生30年后重回禁区，一探辐射污染对当地生物的影响。他们发现当地的辐射污染在多年后依然相当严重，如果待太久会有致命之虞，不过大自然逐渐复苏，虽然辐射对某些生物造成严重的伤害，导致突变，影响繁殖能力，可是生物也演化出适应环境的能力。

programme.title: 苏格兰-守护野生动物第1季:第3集

programme.title: 宝贝乐一通第33集
programme.desc: 在成为叛逆无礼的经典乐一通动画短片前，兔宝宝、太菲鸭和死党们都还是刚学走路的小小孩，天真无邪的好奇宝宝。 特别为学龄前儿童设计的宝贝乐一通将为卡通迷们隆重介绍这些可爱讨喜的小小明星；节目将以较小体型、甜蜜讨喜的方式呈现无比欢乐的经典卡通明星。兔宝宝、太菲鸭、傻大鸟、崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充满冒险行动的维多利亚式宅第中，可是一群鬼灵精怪的小捣蛋鬼。 小兔宝宝和朋友们将邀请所有小小卡通迷，探索这个无奇不有的欢乐世界。

programme.title: 豆豆先生第63集
programme.desc: 在大小银幕上扮演豆豆先生的罗文亚特金(Rowan Atkinson)，这次将自己变身为卡通人物，并为这部动画亲自配音！本系列忠实呈现豆豆先生这个活在真实世界的角色，每一集中，我们不幸的豆豆先生，总要大费周章弄得灰头土脸，才能完成一件简单的小事，那包括找停车位、让邻居安静下来、换沙发或是晒晒太阳等。豆豆先生忠实的搭档泰迪和邪恶的房东卫奇太太，以及她的独眼猫史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾玛也同台演出。这部卡通影集已经在全球150个国家播出，曾经荣获过国际艾美奖和蒙特娄金玫瑰奖的肯定，并引起豆豆先生的热潮，改编成同名电影上映。

programme.title: 少年悍将 Go第1335集
programme.desc: 《少年悍将！GO》是2013年卡通频道和华纳制作的卡通电视节目。也是DC系列《少年悍将》漫画的改编卡通，跟前作不同点在于，本作画法以萌系画风呈现，更大的特点是它著重在喜剧效果上，没有前作的黑暗、严肃气氛，剧中多围绕在少年悍将们的平时生活。本做最大的看点是制作组将许多DC的人物做为背景角色呈现。

programme.title: 机甲猛斗第51集
programme.desc: 在往学校的路上，孟斗遇上了被一群称作锥筒兵的不良机器人在马路中央建造游泳池而造成大塞车。锥筒兵喜爱建造，但是脾气很糟，于是当孟斗指责他们时，他们合体成为一个叫做超级锥筒兵的大机器人攻击孟斗。运用机甲球的机甲化能力，孟斗击败了锥筒兵，但孟斗并没有送他们进监牢，而是同意如果他们将造成的破坏修复，并保证不会再犯，就可以放他们自由。

programme.title: 大砲与小恶魔第468集
programme.desc: 孔武有力又熊大只的大砲，应该在森林里享有崇高地位让大家敬畏才对，偏偏小恶魔完全不甩这套！这群邪恶的旅鼠看起来娇小无害，其实最让人惊骇!小恶魔总是纠团锁定四肢发达但号呆的大砲，不计一切代价就是要搞得天翻地覆永无宁日!到底大砲该怎么面对这一大群难缠的对手?

programme.title: 豆豆先生第138集
programme.desc: 在大小银幕上扮演豆豆先生的罗文亚特金(Rowan Atkinson)，这次将自己变身为卡通人物，并为这部动画亲自配音！本系列忠实呈现豆豆先生这个活在真实世界的角色，每一集中，我们不幸的豆豆先生，总要大费周章弄得灰头土脸，才能完成一件简单的小事，那包括找停车位、让邻居安静下来、换沙发或是晒晒太阳等。豆豆先生忠实的搭档泰迪和邪恶的房东卫奇太太，以及她的独眼猫史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾玛也同台演出。这部卡通影集已经在全球150个国家播出，曾经荣获过国际艾美奖和蒙特娄金玫瑰奖的肯定，并引起豆豆先生的热潮，改编成同名电影上映。

programme.desc: 汤姆猫和杰利鼠的主人要搬家了，牠们成了无家可归的流浪汉，遇到了伤心的小女孩罗比，她的监护人菲格姨妈是一个坏心肠的女人，企图侵吞罗比爸爸留下的亿万财产。罗比逃出后，菲格姨妈为了抓到罗比，还想出了悬赏百万捉拿的诡计。还好罗比的爸爸赶了回来，菲格姨妈的阴谋破灭，而汤姆和杰瑞也有了更大更漂亮的房子，只是牠们之间的战争可没那么容易就结束呢！

programme.title: 摇滚吧！宝贝第109集
programme.desc: 音乐是一种世界语言，当你在一个语言不通的地方，拿起乐器来哼唱几句，就能快速连结彼此的心。对于正处于语言能力疾速发展的儿童，接触音乐更能和 语言学习相辅相成。已有多项研究证明，让发育中的幼儿接触乐器，可以刺激脑部神经，增进创造力，加强耐心及专注力。

programme.title: 难捕第335集
programme.desc: (2019)荣获艾美奖提名的奇趣系列强势加盟卡通频道！两位疯狂科学家－Specs Doc 和 Skinny Doc拚了命也要捉回难捕!这只从实验室里逃脱的黏TT橙色生物！可是身 为伪装界变身达人的难捕~就像他的名字一样难捕! 哪有那么简单就被捉回去! 看来这两位疯狂科学家的日子只会更加失控!更加混乱!

programme.title: 机甲猛斗第51集
programme.desc: 在往学校的路上，孟斗遇上了被一群称作锥筒兵的不良机器人在马路中央建造游泳池而造成大塞车。锥筒兵喜爱建造，但是脾气很糟，于是当孟斗指责他们时，他们合体成为一个叫做超级锥筒兵的大机器人攻击孟斗。运用机甲球的机甲化能力，孟斗击败了锥筒兵，但孟斗并没有送他们进监牢，而是同意如果他们将造成的破坏修复，并保证不会再犯，就可以放他们自由。

programme.title: 人皮兽-孤狼行动第103集
programme.desc: 这部动作喜剧特辑讲述了人皮兽首次独自冒险的故事，他证明了即使没有少年悍将，他也可以成为超级英雄 - 即使没有人相信他。

programme.title: 怪盗乔克第17集
programme.desc: 主人公的怪盗JOKER与助手小八一起，不仅要从警察妨碍中逃出生天，还要与怪盗斯佩德、女怪盗钻告女王斗智斗勇下，一次次将宝物成功盗走。

programme.title: 怪盗乔克第18集

programme.title: 豆豆先生第18集
programme.desc: 在大小银幕上扮演豆豆先生的罗文亚特金(Rowan Atkinson)，这次将自己变身为卡通人物，并为这部动画亲自配音！本系列忠实呈现豆豆先生这个活在真实世界的角色，每一集中，我们不幸的豆豆先生，总要大费周章弄得灰头土脸，才能完成一件简单的小事，那包括找停车位、让邻居安静下来、换沙发或是晒晒太阳等。豆豆先生忠实的搭档泰迪和邪恶的房东卫奇太太，以及她的独眼猫史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾玛也同台演出。这部卡通影集已经在全球150个国家播出，曾经荣获过国际艾美奖和蒙特娄金玫瑰奖的肯定，并引起豆豆先生的热潮，改编成同名电影上映。

programme.title: 飞天小女警第130集
programme.desc: 小镇村本来是一个平凡的小镇，可是自从遗传学家尤教授来到镇上以后，这个平凡的小镇就摇身一变成为一个的举世瞩目的地方，尤教授希望可以运用科学方法，创造出世界上最完美的小女孩，他将蜜糖和香料等各种甜美的材料混在一起，不过他不小心将神秘的化学原素X也给加了进去，结果就创造出三个模样可爱，嫉恶如仇、誓与罪犯周旋到底的飞天小女警。

programme.title: 宝贝乐一通第1集
programme.desc: 在成为叛逆无礼的经典乐一通动画短片前，兔宝宝、太菲鸭和死党们都还是刚学走路的小小孩，天真无邪的好奇宝宝。 特别为学龄前儿童设计的宝贝乐一通将为卡通迷们隆重介绍这些可爱讨喜的小小明星；节目将以较小体型、甜蜜讨喜的方式呈现无比欢乐的经典卡通明星。兔宝宝、太菲鸭、傻大鸟、崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充满冒险行动的维多利亚式宅第中，可是一群鬼灵精怪的小捣蛋鬼。 小兔宝宝和朋友们将邀请所有小小卡通迷，探索这个无奇不有的欢乐世界。

programme.title: 少年悍将 Go第162集
programme.desc: 《少年悍将！GO》是2013年卡通频道和华纳制作的卡通电视节目。也是DC系列《少年悍将》漫画的改编卡通，跟前作不同点在于，本作画法以萌系画风呈现，更大的特点是它著重在喜剧效果上，没有前作的黑暗、严肃气氛，剧中多围绕在少年悍将们的平时生活。本做最大的看点是制作组将许多DC的人物做为背景角色呈现。

programme.title: 人鱼独角兽-星落第202集
programme.desc: 某个神奇夜晚，一群独角兽顺著一颗流星划过天际，坠入神秘的海洋，变成了半独角兽、半鱼的奇幻生物。有一天，当它们追逐迁徙的海豚时，他们首次发现了人类世界的水面。从此，关于「人鱼独角兽」的传说便流传开来──据说，它们只会在月食时现身。

programme.title: 阿甘奇幻妙世界第142集

programme.desc: 故事主要讲述陶阿甘和他的家人在艾尔摩镇里的生活，以及他与陶阿达、家人和朋友互动的各种冒险。 他们经常卷入城市里发生的各种不同寻常的骚动和事件。

programme.title: 爱烦多王子冒险中第5集

programme.title: 乐一通卡通第116集

programme.title: 乐一通卡通第135集

programme.title: 豆豆先生第431集
programme.desc: 在大小银幕上扮演豆豆先生的罗文亚特金(Rowan Atkinson)，这次将自己变身为卡通人物，并为这部动画亲自配音！本系列忠实呈现豆豆先生这个活在真实世界的角色，每一集中，我们不幸的豆豆先生，总要大费周章弄得灰头土脸，才能完成一件简单的小事，那包括找停车位、让邻居安静下来、换沙发或是晒晒太阳等。豆豆先生忠实的搭档泰迪和邪恶的房东卫奇太太，以及她的独眼猫史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾玛也同台演出。这部卡通影集已经在全球150个国家播出，曾经荣获过国际艾美奖和蒙特娄金玫瑰奖的肯定，并引起豆豆先生的热潮，改编成同名电影上映。

programme.title: 摇滚吧！宝贝第111集
programme.desc: 音乐是一种世界语言，当你在一个语言不通的地方，拿起乐器来哼唱几句，就能快速连结彼此的心。对于正处于语言能力疾速发展的儿童，接触音乐更能和 语言学习相辅相成。已有多项研究证明，让发育中的幼儿接触乐器，可以刺激脑部神经，增进创造力，加强耐心及专注力。
